snaps.title: Shipment Tracking
snaps.sub: Stage 22 · existing ERP module — outside this prototype
snaps.body:
Existing ERP moduleExisting Import & Warehouse module. After LC opening it tracks supplier dispatch, packing list, transport documents, ETA and customs clearance.
This module sends
Approved PO + validated PI + LC reference
It sends back
Shipment status, ETA changes, customs clearance records
Hand-off queue4 PO(s) with LC opened, ready for shipment tracking
Integration points are TBD (Open Policy Item 12).
